title: Audit: Find mismatches between visitorId and email usage
description: Search for places where code assumes visitorId equals email, or where the wrong identifier is used for user lookups.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Grep convex/ for queries using visitorId to look up by email field
Grep convex/ for queries using email to look up by visitorId field
Check all .filter() calls that compare email and visitorId
Identify any mutations that create records with wrong ID type
Check TanStack Query cache keys for user-specific data
Document all mismatches found in progress.txt

notes: CODE REVIEW ONLY - DO NOT USE BROWSER. Use grep/read tools only. Known issue: leaderboard.ts uses user.email as visitorId but practice data uses localStorage UUID. Find similar patterns.
